sentence: Driven by a progressive breakdown of blood and tissue integrity, Bothrops Lanceolatus is engaged in a relentless descent from acute inflammatory states into hemorrhage, necrosis, and gangrene, with profound neurological confusion throughout.
references: Herscu, P. ND DHANP. 'Bothrops lanceolatus.' New England Journal of Homeopathy, Vol 8 #2.
Herscu, P. & Rothenberg, A. NESH curriculum materials.

segments.name: Inflammation and swelling
segments.description: Acute inflammatory onset with rapid swelling. Edema, erythema, heat. Pain intense, burning. Lymphangitis, adenitis. Thrombophlebitis. Vessels inflamed and tortuous.

segments.name: Hemorrhage and bleeding
segments.description: Bleeding from every orifice and into tissues. Blood dark, fluid, non-coagulating. Ecchymoses, petechiae. Hematuria, epistaxis, hemoptysis. Bleeding gums. Vomiting blood.

segments.name: Necrosis and tissue death
segments.description: Tissue breakdown, gangrene, sloughing. Blackened, mortified tissue. Vesicles with bloody serum. Abscesses, ulcers. Rapid tissue destruction. Foul odor.

segments.name: Paralysis and neurological collapse
segments.description: Progressive paralysis, especially lower limbs. Inability to articulate speech. Aphasia, stammering. Vertigo, fainting. Amnesia, confusion. Brain fog. Hemiplegia. Speech comes slowly.

segments.name: Fear of death and confusion
segments.description: Profuse cold sweat, pale, collapsed. Anxiety about death, feels he will die. Delirium, sees persons who are not there. Thinks he is not at home. Memory completely lost. Cannot recognize anyone.
